definitions.explanation: The act of winding something onto a spool, reel, or roll. Used for thread, fishing line, tape, film, cable, and similar materials.

definitions.gloss: a roll (of paper, film, etc.); wound material
definitions.explanation: Material that has been wound into a roll, or a product sold in roll form, such as paper towels or plastic wrap.

examples.japanese: {糸|いと}の{巻|ま}き{取|と}りをする。
リールの{巻|ま}き{取|と}りが{速|はや}くて{魚|さかな}を{逃|に}がさなかった。
examples.english: The reel retrieval was fast and I didn't let the fish get away.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}ではフィルムの{巻|ま}き{取|と}り{速度|そくど}を{自動|じどう}で{調整|ちょうせい}している。
examples.english: In the factory, the film winding speed is adjusted automatically.

examples.japanese: {巻|ま}き{取|と}り{式|しき}のコードは{便利|べんり}だ。
トイレットペーパーの{巻|ま}き{取|と}りが{残|のこ}り{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: The toilet paper roll is almost empty.

examples.japanese: この{巻|ま}き{取|と}り{紙|がみ}は{一巻|ひとまき}で{百|ひゃく}メートルある。
examples.english: This roll of paper is 100 meters per roll.

notes:
Compound noun from {巻|ま}く (to wind, to roll) + {取|と}る (to take). Commonly encountered in everyday life (fishing, household products) and in industrial/manufacturing contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巻|ま}き{取|と}り{式|しき}: retractable type; reel-type
- {巻|ま}き{取|と}り{機|き}: winding machine; winder
- {巻|ま}き{取|と}り{速度|そくど}: winding speed
- {巻|ま}き{取|と}り{紙|がみ}: roll paper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {巻|ま}く: to wind, to roll — the base verb
- リール: reel — the device that winds
- スプール: spool — another winding device (loanword)
